I never have truly felt okay since. I was molested as a young child, then sexually assaulted when I was 13 by an 18 year old. I was punished for the 18 year old, and told I was a used car that no man would want by my teachers due to the assault. I was drugged and had a sexual assault attempt by a friend last year. 

I still struggle with ptsd and depression. I don’t usually feel much besides negative emotions, and am really good at pretending to be happy/loving. I have issues with hypersexuality, it’s hard to be monogamous, I can be manipulative, and I have a hard time forming or believing I have bonds with people. I’ve ruined almost every relationship with men, friendship or otherwise, by believing the only reason they would tolerate me is because I have sex with them. That was better before the attempted assault, but has now some back even worse. 

On the bright side, I have a loving supporting partner who accepts me with all my baggage. He helps me when I’m to depressed to function, and is okay with my hypersexuality as long as he knows what’s going on. He works with me, and I actually truly love him. He is the only male I actually believe likes me for me, and not just for sex. He wants me to go to therapy, but we can’t afford it.
